partner.description:
At Georges, you can find good food, great music and mad people. All Georges outlets provide a cozy, friendly and laidback vibe that is perfect for a night out with friends. Choose from a wide selection of beers, whiskies, cocktails, and Guinness Draft and western menu options with sumptuous pub grub at reasonable prices. 

Participating Outlets: 
•	Georges Beach Club (East Coast Parkway)
•	Georges By The Bay (The Punggol Settlement)
•	Georges Hideout @ Seletar (JTC Aviation 2)
•	Georges MADBar & Grill (Frankel Estate)
•	Georges @ Changi Cargo (Airline Road) 
•	Georges @ The Cove (Pasir Ris Road)
